title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode5 Delivering Our Thoughts

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, good!
We're all set for our dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness! I'm glad we finally figured it out...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming up with this, Haruka. I'm sure the students will really enjoy this since they should be able to learn it and dance with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means our show is good to go and so are all our props... Which just leaves our little sneak preview for the event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We haven't done anything like this yet, so I'm sure our viewers will get a kick out of it too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's getting pretty late, so shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
How about we all visit a cafe after this? I feel like we deserve a little reward for all our hard work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then why don't we stop by where I work? We're doing a special dessert menu right now for a limited time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we should go!
What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, can I get a raincheck today?
There's something I need to do after this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Have fun, you guys!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What's going on with her? She didn't mention anything about having to go somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That message must really be eating away at her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think so too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about? What message?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember when we read all those student messages? We think Airi saw one that really bothered her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here... This one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <My favorite part was when you dressed up as The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <The way you fought against really strong people and fell into all those mud traps was the best! I can't believe I get to meet the real Happy Everyday!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember Happy Everyday! Airi played her on that variety show, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is what's bothering her? I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I was part of QT, the only job offers I would get were for variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Airi Momoi that appeared on variety shows always wore a confident smile and never missed the opportunity for a clever quip no matter what anyone said to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After a while, the public started seeing me as nothing more than “that girl” from those shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Eventually, random people started saying things to me when I was just going about my own business, expecting me to “have a good comeback” or “laugh it off”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A person's image can be a powerful thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in my case, the hardest part was having the agency and my fans expecting me to be “Variety Show Airi Momoi”...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was pretty tough being told nobody wanted to see Airi Momoi the idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi hardly ever talks about her own past, so it's easy for us to believe that she isn't bothered by it anymore. But I guess it still does in some small ways...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When she was on all those variety shows, losing her identity as a proper idol just kept weighing down on her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
It'd be hard not to forget something like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's true that people didn't necessarily want to see Airi as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But some time ago, when she was about to change agencies...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She told me that she feels like she hasn't been able to deliver anything to anyone as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I tried to cheer her up by saying that's not true, but it didn't help much in the end...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This also happened a while ago, but we were on a show together this one time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It was just during a short segment for this one show where Airi briefly appeared in a video. We weren't actually on set together but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please continue, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. It was a thirty-second slot where Airi and her group would introduce some new songs by other idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They weren't necessarily well-known idols either, but they did a great job describing them to everyone while throwing in a few laughs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't really know Airi then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But her work ethic and dedication really left an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so true. She's always been such a hard worker and so passionate about being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because she takes being an idol so seriously and loves it so much, she even made me want to work a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it's so sad that others don't get to see that side of her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for her?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't know. How can we cheer her up...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did you think of something, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, what if we tried this...?
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why did you say that, you knucklehead...? Now they're gonna be really worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That event happens less than a week from now too. I need to get myself together, fast...
<Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Who's there?
Where's that voice coming from...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's me, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Len?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I'm having trouble coming up with what to talk about during our show.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Everyone says that you're the best at coming up with this kind of stuff, so I was hoping to pick your brain a little.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I also know that you're busy planning your own event, so you don't have to if you don't have time!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, it's okay. I'll help...
I could really use a distraction right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Never mind that!
Let's go, Len!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, Airi!
Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I heard that you're having trouble coming up with what to talk about while you're MCing, so I'm here to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What specifically are you having trouble with...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len wants to be all cool and suave, but I think it's super lame!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm not trying to. It's just how it sort of came out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're pretty much trying to get a whole standup routine in there, Rin. Can't we just talk like normal?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're idols, so we should try to show everyone how we are just naturally...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we're idols, so I want everyone to have as much fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, you two, time out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Neither of you are wrong, per se.
But you need to strike a balance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You two have amazing chemistry, so you should use that and think about how you want to say what you want to talk about when...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, Airi!
